submit_reasoning:
The price history (137 daily bars) shows LSCC trending from ~55.55 down to a trough near 49.72, then recovering to a recent high of ~58.46 and closing at 58.29. Series statistics: mean 53.64, std 1.94, CV 3.6%. No meaningful seasonality was detected (strength 0.0). Anomaly detection flagged the last 5 bars as elevated (robust z-scores ~3.7-3.8), consistent with the sharp recent rally.

I attempted to incorporate context events from the article (Q2 2021 earnings beat, Zacks Rank #2 Buy, favorable estimate revisions), but all three were rejected by Aion's ablation gate — the article date (August 2021) falls outside the price history window (which ends around May 2020), so the events cannot be leakage-safely admitted. Both the history-only and event-informed runs fell back to the same last_value model with identical trajectories.

The selected model is last_value with degraded support (only 2 rolling folds available, no held-out test fold). The forecast is a flat 60.935 across all 33 steps. While this is a simple model, it is the best available given the data constraints and the inability to admit external context events.
